intent: Technical Brief: Asus ROG Flow X16 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to excessive CPU temperatures during intense gaming sessions or overclocking
suggested_solution: Use ThrottleStop (software tool) to adjust CPU voltage and frequency.
Utilize RU.efi (EFI firmware modification tool) to modify BIOS settings, but note that this may void warranty and requires technical expertise.
Consider using a different cooling solution or adjusting the system's thermal settings to reduce temperatures.
